_meta.WARNING_templates: USE THE FRESH BLANKS from tdlr.texas.gov (assets/). The PDFs originally supplied to this project had been opened in an editor and were mangled three ways: (1) residual test values, including /General Partnership and Renewal pre-ticked; (2) the /Sig signature fields STRIPPED; (3) the /DR font resource STRIPPED. Never source a template from an edited copy. Regardless: the fill routine MUST zero every field before writing (CLAUDE.md D7).
_meta.packet_math: N convictions => 1 x ENF006 (carries conviction #1) + (N-1) x ENF003
_meta.flatten: Flatten on output. Text is burned into the page -> identical on every printer.
_meta.signature_fields: BOTH forms carry a /Sig (cryptographic digital signature) field, and the AcroForm sets /SigFlags 1. NEVER POPULATE THEM. Invariant L6: the user signs in wet ink; liability transfers at physical execution. form.flatten() has been smoke-tested with /Sig present and works.
_meta.slash_convention: THIS MAP STORES THE TRUE PDF EXPORT VALUE, WITH THE SLASH ('/Choice3', '/No'). That is what is actually inside the PDF. pdf-lib's select() wants the BARE name ('Choice3', 'No') and THROWS if you pass the slash. Do not 'fix' the map. The tickButton() adapter strips the slash. Map stays true; the adapter absorbs the quirk.
_meta.off_is_not_an_option: /Off IS NOT A SELECTABLE VALUE. It is the ABSENCE of a selection. select('Off') throws. To leave a radio group unticked, CLEAR it -- see CLAUDE.md F11 and the clearButton() primitive. Verified against the real blanks in the Phase 0 probe.

ENF006._note: Carries the applicant data AND CONVICTION #1. 33 fields (32 fillable + 1 /Sig).

SSN.reason: Invariant D3. Left empty; user hand-writes in pen.

business_branch._note: Hidden in UI unless the user is a controlling person of a company. When hidden, write 'N/A' to the text fields (no blanks allowed, F6) and leave Type of Ownership at /Off.

ownership_type.NOT_A_BUSINESS_OWNER: There is NO value for 'not a business owner'. The five below are the ONLY options this field has -- verified by reading the field's on-values off the real blank (Phase 0 probe). '/Off' is NOT among them; it is the absence of a selection, and select('Off') THROWS. When the user is not a controlling person of a company (the DEFAULT and the common case), CLEAR this group -- never select it. An earlier revision of this map listed "none": "/Off", which reads as fine in review and ships a pre-ticked General Partnership. See CLAUDE.md F11 and D7.

conviction_1._TRAP: The field NAMED 'County and State of conviction or deferred adjudication' holds the COUNTY ONLY. The state goes in the separate field 'State (ex: Texas)'. Writing 'Harris, Texas' into the first field is WRONG and leaves the second blank.

on_parole.CORRECTED_2026_07_14: THIS WAS INVERTED IN THE PREVIOUS REVISION OF THIS MAP, which said no=/Choice1, yes=/Choice3. Verified by widget geometry against the real blank: on the printed form 'No' is the LEFT box and 'Yes' is the RIGHT box. #17 widgets: x=192 -> /Choice3 (NO), x=226 -> /Choice1 (YES). The old map ticked YES for a man who is NOT on parole. Every automated test passed; pdf-lib validated the value; the PDF was well-formed. Only PRINTING THE PAGE caught it.
on_parole.WARNING: NON-SEQUENTIAL and semantically arbitrary. /Choice1 means YES here and NO on #16. The number carries no meaning. Never reason from it.
